name: js-chunk
instruction: Implement chunk.js (CommonJS): module.exports = chunk. chunk(arr, size) splits arr into consecutive arrays of length `size`; the final chunk holds the remainder. chunk([], n) returns []. size must be a positive INTEGER — throw a RangeError for size < 1 or a non-integer size. Do not mutate arr.
verifyCmd: node -e "const c=require('./chunk.js');const eq=(a,b)=>JSON.stringify(a)===JSON.stringify(b);if(!eq(c([1,2,3,4],2),[[1,2],[3,4]]))process.exit(1);if(!eq(c([1,2,3],2),[[1,2],[3]]))process.exit(1);if(!eq(c([],3),[]))process.exit(1);const src=[1,2,3];c(src,2);if(!eq(src,[1,2,3])){console.error('mutated');process.exit(1)}for(const bad of [0,-1,1.5,'2']){try{c([1,2],bad);console.error('no throw',bad);process.exit(1)}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof RangeError)){console.error('wrong error',bad);process.exit(1)}}}console.log('ok')"
